packs.title: Beyond the Palace Green
packs.promise: Brick paths, painted wings and a reservoir lookout beyond Williamsburg’s historic core.

q.s: Walk a level edge and watch the lawn change depth.
st: Stand at the east end and look along the length of the lawn.
Follow one rim toward the west, stopping where you can see both the lower lawn and the upper walk.
Describe the point where the change of level was easiest to see.

q.s: Curate two works that deserve to meet.
st: Choose a work that catches your eye and read its label.
Find a second work elsewhere in an open general gallery with a color, shape or subject in common.
Write a two-work exhibition title and the detail that earned it.

q.s: Follow two pieces of color through a painted quilt.
st: Find the woman quilting in the mural.
Look for two patches your eye travels between. Notice what joins them in the painting.
Describe the route between your patches using color and position.

packs.title: Along Duke of Gloucester
packs.promise: Read the roofs, rooms and working tools of Colonial Williamsburg.

q.s: Turn a brick house into a quick symmetry puzzle.
st: Line up with the center of the brick front as well as the sidewalk allows.
Sketch one side of the facade, then use the other half of the page to predict its mirror image.
Look again and circle a match or mark one surprise.

q.s: Collect three parts of an old public building in outline.
st: Stand where the courthouse front is easy to see.
Choose a roof detail, an opening and an edge that touches the sky.
List them from highest to lowest and see if a companion could pick the building from that list.

q.s: Describe what brings people into a tavern room.
st: Listen for a use of the tavern that goes beyond serving food.
Choose one room or furnishing on the visit and one activity that belongs with it.
Write a six-word invitation to that activity in your own voice.
